title: Characteristic cycles of real and complex constructible sheaves, revisited
summary: For a smooth morphism $f: X \longrightarrow Σ$ of real analytic manifolds and an $\mathbb{R}$-constructible sheaf $F$ on $X$ satisfying some condition, we define a family of Lagrangian cycles parameterized by $Σ$ that we call the relative characteristic cycle of $F$ for $f$. In this way, the theory of characteristic cycles due to Kashiwara and Schapira is naturally extended to the relative setting.
